intended_object: The principal ideal (x^N) in the coordinate ring K[x] of the additive group 𝔾_a over a commutative ring K, where x is the standard coordinate. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation; the quotient by it is K[x]/(x^N), which gives α_{p^m} when N = p^m in characteristic p (Milne 2.5).
explanation: The coordinate ring `additiveGroupCoordinateRing K` is `SymmetricAlgebra K K`, which is isomorphic to K[X]. `additiveGroupCoordinate K` is `ι 1`, and the library proves it maps to `Polynomial.X`. The definition is `Ideal.span {x ^ N}`, which is exactly the principal ideal (x^N). It is stated for any commutative ring K and any N, which is the natural generality. The cases N = 0 (the whole ring) and N = 1 (the augmentation-type ideal (x)) are the expected degenerate values. This is a specific ideal in the library's own model of 𝒪(𝔾_a), so it has no separate Mathlib counterpart. The library itself shows the quotient by this ideal is `AdjoinRoot (X ^ N)`, as intended.
